spec.title: Temperature
spec.description: Live temperature, averaged per 5 s. Yellow line = warning (45 °C), red line = alarm (60 °C).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(measurement.time, '5s'),
       sensor.name AS metric,
       avg(measurement.value) AS value
FROM measurement
JOIN sensor      ON sensor.sensor_id    = measurement.sensor_id
JOIN sensor_type ON sensor_type.type_id = sensor.type_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(measurement.time) AND sensor_type.name = 'Temperature'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Smoke & metal detection
spec.description: Smoke detector and magnetic sensor. Red = smoke in the hall or metal detected on the conveyor

spec.rawSql:
SELECT measurement.time AS time,
       sensor.name AS metric,
       measurement.value AS value
FROM measurement
JOIN sensor ON sensor.sensor_id = measurement.sensor_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(measurement.time) AND sensor.name IN ('smoke_01', 'magnetic_01')
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Discharge voltage
spec.description: Cell voltage at the discharge station. Above 2.0 V per cell = not safely discharged

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(measurement.time, '5s'),
       sensor.name AS metric,
       avg(measurement.value) AS value
FROM measurement
JOIN sensor      ON sensor.sensor_id    = measurement.sensor_id
JOIN sensor_type ON sensor_type.type_id = sensor.type_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(measurement.time) AND sensor_type.name = 'Voltage'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Battery weight
spec.description: Weight of each battery on the conveyor. Above 2.0 kg = invalid weight, check the battery

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(measurement.time, '5s'),
       sensor.name AS metric,
       avg(measurement.value) AS value
FROM measurement
JOIN sensor      ON sensor.sensor_id    = measurement.sensor_id
JOIN sensor_type ON sensor_type.type_id = sensor.type_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(measurement.time) AND sensor_type.name = 'Weight'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Vibration
spec.description: Machine vibration (ISO 20816-3). Warning at 3.5 mm/s, alarm at 4.5 mm/s: the machine needs maintenance

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(measurement.time, '10s'),
       sensor.name AS metric,
       avg(measurement.value) AS value
FROM measurement
JOIN sensor      ON sensor.sensor_id    = measurement.sensor_id
JOIN sensor_type ON sensor_type.type_id = sensor.type_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(measurement.time) AND sensor_type.name = 'Vibration'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Battery condition
spec.description: Battery condition seen by the camera. Dented, swollen or leaking batteries must be set aside

spec.rawSql:
SELECT measurement.raw_condition AS condition,
       count(*) AS batteries
FROM measurement
JOIN sensor ON sensor.sensor_id = measurement.sensor_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(measurement.time) AND sensor.name = 'vision_01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.title: Battery types
spec.description: Battery types recognised by the camera (AA, AAA, 18650, pouch…)

spec.rawSql:
SELECT measurement.battery_type AS type,
       count(*) AS batteries
FROM measurement
JOIN sensor ON sensor.sensor_id = measurement.sensor_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(measurement.time) AND sensor.name = 'vision_01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT avg(m.confidence_score) AS confidence
FROM measurement m
JOIN sensor s ON s.sensor_id = m.sensor_id
WHERE s.name = 'vision_01' AND $__timeFilter(m.time);

spec.title: Latest alarms
spec.description: Warnings and alarms raised by the edge gateway, newest first. Threshold = the limit that was crossed at that moment.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT alarm.time, sensor.name AS sensor, alarm.level, alarm.value, alarm.threshold
FROM alarm
JOIN sensor ON sensor.sensor_id = alarm.sensor_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(alarm.time)
ORDER BY alarm.time DESC
LIMIT 50

spec.title: Offline sensors
spec.description: ensors that sent nothing for more than 3× their send interval. A silent sensor can hide a real danger.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT sensor.name AS sensor, max(measurement.time) AS last_reading
FROM sensor
JOIN sensor_type      ON sensor_type.type_id      = sensor.type_id
LEFT JOIN measurement ON measurement.sensor_id    = sensor.sensor_id
GROUP BY sensor.name, sensor_type.send_interval_s
HAVING max(measurement.time) IS NULL
    OR max(measurement.time) < now() - 3 * sensor_type.send_interval_s * interval '1 second'

spec.title: Message delivery (%)
spec.description: Share of messages that reached the database, based on gaps in the sequence numbers.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT sensor.name AS sensor,
       round(100.0 * count(*) / (max(measurement.sequence_number) - min(measurement.sequence_number) + 1), 1) AS delivery_pct
FROM measurement
JOIN sensor ON sensor.sensor_id = measurement.sensor_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(measurement.time)
GROUP BY sensor.name
ORDER BY delivery_pct

spec.title: Message delay (ms)
spec.description: Time between the sensor reading and its arrival in the database.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT sensor.name AS sensor,
       round(max(extract(epoch FROM measurement.received_at - measurement.time) * 1000)) AS max_delay_ms
FROM measurement
JOIN sensor ON sensor.sensor_id = measurement.sensor_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(measurement.time)
GROUP BY sensor.name
ORDER BY max_delay_ms DESC

spec.title: Battery sorting errors
spec.description: Number of batteries per step and error code. Shows where in the sorting process problems happen

spec.rawSql:
SELECT battery_event.step || ' – ' || battery_event.error_code AS problem,
       count(*) AS batteries
FROM battery_event
WHERE battery_event.error_code IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(battery_event.time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(measurement.time, '5s'),
       sensor.name AS metric,
       avg(measurement.value) AS value
FROM measurement
JOIN sensor      ON sensor.sensor_id    = measurement.sensor_id
JOIN sensor_type ON sensor_type.type_id = sensor.type_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(measurement.time) AND sensor_type.name = 'Carbon monoxide'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Hydrogen

spec.rawSql:

       sensor.name AS metric,
